home.title: Made for your home.
home.description: Bespoke kitchens and furniture. Over 40 years of experience turning ideas into spaces to live in.

home.introTitle: Some homes call for something unique.
home.introText: A kitchen where everything has its place. A wardrobe that makes every centimetre count. A piece of furniture that feels as though it has always belonged. We build around your space, your needs and the people who live there.
home.craftTitle: The difference is in the details.
home.craftText: In the choice of materials, the meeting of two pieces, a carefully finished surface. Our own manufacturing allows us to follow every stage and create furniture built for everyday life.
home.processTitle: From your first idea to your home.
home.locationTitle: Close to you. In Greater Lisbon.
home.locationText: We are based in Odivelas and work mainly in Lisbon and the surrounding area. Every project starts with a conversation about your space.

about.label: ABOUT MÓVEIS MACHADO
about.title: Experience in every piece.
about.text: We manufacture bespoke furniture in Odivelas. With over 40 years of experience and our own production, we support residential projects from planning through to installation.
about.secondTitle: Your home. Our attention to detail.
about.secondText: Every space has different dimensions, uses and possibilities. Our role is to understand those details and translate them into furniture that belongs in your home. We bring together individual design, knowledge of materials and careful workmanship.

process.title: We listen
process.text: We get to know your space, your ideas and the needs of the project.

process.title: We plan
process.text: We define dimensions, layout, materials and finishes.

process.title: We make
process.text: We manufacture your furniture ourselves, with care for every detail.

process.title: We install
process.text: We bring the project into your home and carry out the installation.

faq.a: Kitchens, wardrobes, bespoke furniture and interior doors for homes. Each solution is defined around the space and the individual project.
We are based in Odivelas and work mainly in Lisbon and the surrounding area. Location and project conditions are discussed during the initial enquiry.

faq.q: Do you manufacture your own furniture?
faq.a: Yes. Móveis Machado manufactures its furniture and supports each project from planning through to installation.
We work with solid wood, lacquered MDF and technical materials. Material and finish options are chosen to suit each project’s needs.

faq.q: How can I prepare a quotation request?
faq.a: Gather approximate dimensions, photographs of the space and references for what you have in mind. Timing and price depend on the scope, materials and project conditions.

legalPages.privacyIntro: This presentation version does not accept online enquiries until current contact channels and the data controller’s information have been confirmed.
legalPages.legalIntro: Móveis Machado is the trading name shown on this website. Full legal identification and current contact details await confirmation before public launch.
legalPages.accessibilityIntro: We want everyone to be able to use this website. Its design and development are guided by WCAG 2.2, Level AA.

privacySections.title: Contact enquiries
privacySections.text: Once the form is active, it will request name, email, project type and message. Phone will be optional. The purpose will be to respond and take pre-contractual steps where applicable, under Article 6(1)(b) of the GDPR.

privacySections.title: Providers and security
privacySections.text: This presentation is hosted through Sites on Cloudflare infrastructure. Planned email delivery uses Resend and abuse protection uses Cloudflare Turnstile. These services will only be activated for the form after configuration and review of processing terms and applicable transfers.

privacySections.title: Retention and rights
privacySections.text: The retention period, controller identity and contact channel for rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability will be confirmed before collection. Complaints may be submitted to the Portuguese Data Protection Authority at cnpd.pt.

privacySections.title: Cookies and external content
privacySections.text: The application includes no analytics, advertising, marketing pixels or embedded maps. Hosting infrastructure may use mechanisms necessary for security and access control. Cookies actually used must be reviewed for the public version. External links open only when you select them.

legalSections.title: Location
legalSections.text: Rua Vítor Cordon 6A, 2675-459 Odivelas, Portugal. Full opening hours are not published without confirmation.

legalSections.title: Identification and consumer information
legalSections.text: Legal entity name, tax identification, registration information and current contact details must be available before public launch. Registration in the Portuguese electronic complaints book and the competent alternative dispute resolution entity require business confirmation.

legalSections.title: Content and photographs
legalSections.text: Services are described using supplied information and the company website. Photographs come from the published Móveis Machado archive and are used in this private presentation; reuse permission must be confirmed before public publication.

legalSections.title: Quotations
legalSections.text: This website does not support online purchases or contracting. Scope, materials, price and conditions are defined in the relevant quotation and agreement.

accessibilitySections.title: Using the site
accessibilitySections.text: You can navigate with the keyboard, use the skip link, open menus and enlarge photographs. The gallery closes with Escape and supports arrow keys.

accessibilitySections.title: Preferences and reading
accessibilitySections.text: The site adapts to small screens, includes form labels and respects reduced-motion preferences. It does not rely on animation to convey information.

accessibilitySections.title: Ongoing improvements
accessibilitySections.text: The WCAG 2.2 AA target is not a certification. Evaluation with assistive technologies and a contact channel to report difficulties must be completed and confirmed before public launch.
